descriptors.name: Distinct illustration regions
descriptors.definition: Number category of spatially separated non-writing illustration regions.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Touching components forming one composition count once; any two or more separated regions are MULTIPLE.
descriptors.annotation_instructions: Count regions separated by clear whitespace or running-writing blocks; record 0, 1, or MULTIPLE.
negative_examples: Leaves of one plant are not separate regions.

descriptors.name: Central illustration
descriptors.definition: A major illustration overlaps the central third of the unit.
descriptors.annotation_instructions: Use the unit bounds, not the physical spread bounds.
positive_examples: A major circle centered in the panel.

descriptors.name: Plant-like object count
descriptors.definition: Count of major forms with a stem/root/leaf-like branching silhouette, without botanical identification.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Detached fragments count separately only when spatially isolated.
negative_examples: A purely geometric radial diagram is 0.

descriptors.name: Human-like figure count
descriptors.definition: Count of forms with an apparent head and torso/limb configuration.
descriptors.annotation_instructions: Do not infer identity, sex or action.

descriptors.name: Container-like object count
descriptors.definition: Count of bounded receptacle-like forms with a rim/body or enclosed pool-like boundary.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Do not decide what a container holds.

descriptors.name: Star-like symbols present
descriptors.definition: Presence of one or more discrete symbols with at least five salient rays or petal-like points.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Do not estimate a count in dense groups; record 1+ whenever any qualifying symbol is visible.
positive_examples: A margin with ten ray symbols is 4+.

descriptors.name: Major circular unit count
descriptors.definition: Count of major circle/ring-centered diagram units.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Nested rings sharing one center are one unit.

descriptors.name: Radial organization
descriptors.definition: Major visual elements are arranged around a common apparent center.

descriptors.name: Concentric organization
descriptors.definition: Two or more major closed contours share an apparent center.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Distorted but clearly nested contours may be PRESENT.
descriptors.annotation_instructions: Require at least two nested contours.

descriptors.name: Branching organization
descriptors.definition: A major form splits hierarchically into two or more branches.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Repeated adjacent strokes without a parent stem are ABSENT.
descriptors.annotation_instructions: Shape only; plant interpretation is unnecessary.

descriptors.name: Figure relation
descriptors.missing_policy: NOT_APPLICABLE when fewer than two figures are visible.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Interaction requires touch, shared enclosure or visible connector.
positive_examples: Two figures sharing a bounded region are INTERACTING.
negative_examples: Separated figures with no shared structure are ISOLATED.
descriptors.not_applicable_rule: Fewer than two visible human-like figures.

descriptors.name: Figures in enclosures
descriptors.definition: At least one human-like figure lies substantially inside a bounded compartment or receptacle form.
descriptors.missing_policy: NOT_APPLICABLE when no figures are visible.
positive_examples: A torso inside a closed pool boundary.
negative_examples: A figure standing beside a circle.

descriptors.name: Radially arranged writing
descriptors.definition: Writing baselines visibly follow radial or circular paths around a center.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Code baseline geometry without reading signs.

descriptors.name: Visual mark density
descriptors.definition: Density of non-writing illustrative marks within the unit.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Judge filled area and line concentration jointly.
descriptors.annotation_instructions: LOW=sparse/none; MEDIUM=one developed motif; HIGH=dense multi-region marks.
negative_examples: Dense running writing alone remains LOW.

descriptors.name: Structural complexity
descriptors.definition: Number of visually distinct structural relations among major non-writing elements.
descriptors.ambiguity_policy: Use explicit anchors: one/no relation LOW, 2-3 MEDIUM, 4+ HIGH.
descriptors.annotation_instructions: Relations include nesting, branching, linking, enclosure and repetition.
positive_examples: Nested, radial and repeated elements are HIGH.
negative_examples: A single unconnected motif is LOW.
